import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/full2.json'))
for p in d['parts']:
    name=p['part']
    e=p['export']
    sc=e.get('spec_check')
    print('=== PART',name,'ok=',e['ok'],'spec_ok=',sc.get('ok') if sc else None)
    if sc and not sc.get('ok'):
        print(json.dumps(sc,indent=1)[:2000])
a=d.get('assembly')
print('=== ASSEMBLY')
print(json.dumps(a.get('problems'),indent=1)[:4000])
print('motions=',json.dumps(a.get('motions'))[:2000])
print('spec_check=',json.dumps(a.get('spec_check'))[:2000])
print('print_in_place=',json.dumps(a.get('print_in_place'))[:3000])
print('held=',a.get('held'))
print('steps=',json.dumps(a.get('assembly_steps'))[:2000])
EOF
